metadata.scenario: A woman calls for the first time asking about in-home physical therapy for her elderly father after hip surgery. She asks about pricing and weekly visit frequency. The receptionist provides a quote for three visits per week at $120 per session. The caller is relieved and says she'll confirm tomorrow. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Sarah. I'm calling about in-home physical therapy for my father. He just had hip surgery. I’m glad you called, Sarah. I can definitely help with that. Can I get a bit more information about your father? Sure! He’s 78 years old and he's recovering well, but he needs help with mobility and strength training. That makes sense. We can offer physical therapy sessions tailored to his needs. How often were you thinking of scheduling? I was thinking maybe three times a week. Is that feasible? Yes, absolutely. Our sessions are priced at $120 each. Oh, that’s reasonable! So that would be $360 a week then? Correct, that would cover three sessions a week at that rate. Great! And how long is each session? Each session lasts about 45 to 60 minutes. That sounds perfect. I just want to make sure he's getting the best care possible. We understand how important that is. Our therapists are highly qualified and experienced. Thank you! I really appreciate your help. I’ll need to discuss this with my siblings, but I think we’ll go for it. Of course, feel free to take your time. Would you like me to send over some information via email? Yes, that would be helpful! Can you send it to my email, sarah.thompson@email.com? Absolutely, I’ll send that over shortly. Thank you! I’ll confirm tomorrow after I talk with my siblings. Sounds good, Sarah. Just let me know if you have any other questions. I will, thanks again! You're welcome! Have a great day. You too, bye! Goodbye!
